_comment: Colour literals allowed to survive the reskin.
Matched by FILE + a distinctive CONTEXT substring from the same line + the LITERAL --
never by literal alone. '#fff' appears twenty times in this repo and only three of them are
QR quiet zones; a literal-only allowlist would wave the other seventeen through.
Context rather than line number, deliberately. An earlier version matched line numbers and
went stale the first time anything was inserted above an entry -- the census reported three
stale entries after a single unrelated edit. A substring survives the file moving around it,
and is still specific enough to name one element.
An entry whose context is no longer found anywhere is REPORTED as stale, not ignored: a
drifted allowlist is how a forbidden colour walks back in unnoticed.

chart.min.js.why: vendored Chart.js v4.5.1 -- never edited by hand

site/**.why: the marketing site is the SOURCE of this palette, not a target

worker/**.why: Cloudflare Worker, deployed separately, cannot link tokens.css

lines.why: Google brand mark -- trademark. The sign-in button is required to look like Google's. Two verbatim copies of this SVG exist.
2FA QR quiet zone. A QR on black is unscannable -- the radius could go, the white cannot.
invoice QR quiet zone on the standalone payment page
